title: Promotions
description: Manage featured and sponsored listing promotions.

help.title: About Promotions
help.overview: A promotion boosts one listing as featured or sponsored for a start-to-end window. It runs while its lifecycle is active and today is inside its dates. Lifecycle is active, paused, or stopped and is changed only by actions.

sections.title: Creating
items: The listing's provider, or an administrator, promotes an active listing.
Type is featured or sponsored. Start and end bound when the boost applies.

sections.title: Lifecycle
sections.body: Pause, resume, and stop need ownership of the listing, or an administrator.
items: Pause is only from active: the boost stops without ending the campaign.
Resume is only from paused, and only while the end date is still in the future.
Stop ends the promotion for good with a stop reason; it cannot be resumed.

sections.title: Effect
items: On the storefront's recommended sort, listings with a running promotion come first, newest first, then the rest.
Deleted promotions cannot be paused, resumed, or stopped until restored.
